The one-box-at-the-top layout feels right, and newest first is a sensible default.

The automatic details are a bit too limited, though. I’d expect the page title, a short description, the actual site icon, and a preview image when the page provides one—not just the site name and an initial. I’d also want to be able to correct the title or description before finishing the save, as well as edit them later.

I couldn’t load the live address to try the interaction myself, so please show me the corrected save result and editing step.
